title: Does one Blue rule out a Red goal?
hook: A noisy demonstrator chooses Red, Red, then Blue.

knows: A grid world: an agent moves, collects points, ends at a goal.
doesNotKnow: Use observed choices to update reward-hypothesis beliefs under an explicit noisy behaviour model.

objective: Use observed choices to update reward-hypothesis beliefs under an explicit noisy behaviour model.
misconception: One deviation proves the demonstrator has a different goal.

claims.text: R rewards Red2/Blue0; B rewards Red0/Blue2. Both actions terminate in one state. Priors are.5/.5.

claims.text: Independent episodes conditional on hypothesis; specified demonstrator chooses the uniquely better action with probability.8 and worse with.2. This is not a measured human parameter.
